reasons: CS4278 in Y3S1 (semester 5) requires CS3263 or CS3243 completed earlier. CS3263 requires CS2109S earlier, but CS2109S is not completed before semester 4.
CS3243 cannot be used instead because it is mutually exclusive with CS2109S, which the student must take. Thus no plan satisfies all hard constraints.
